# Supplemental upstream license texts

These texts supplement Python wheels that declare a license but omit its text.
They do not relicense ProjectWatch or confer rights to unrelated model weights.
The Windows builder includes this directory through the root LICENSES tree.

line endings. Retain each complete text and attribution when distributing.
Changing a dependency version requires checking its corresponding notice again.
